mil7.2.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, kalandakassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetban ti. -
mil7.2.3:1.2: Yathā mahārāja kalandako paṭisattumhi opatante nanguṭṭhaṃ papphoṭetvā mahantaṃ katvā ten' eva nanguṭṭhalakuṭena paṭisattuṃ paṭibāhati,
mil7.2.3:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kilesasattumhi opatante satipaṭṭhānalakuṭaṃ papphoṭetvā mahantaṃ katvā ten' eva satipaṭṭhānalakuṭena sabbe kilesā paṭibāhitabbā.
mil7.2.3:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja kalandakassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
